title: OpenMHS driver lock (driver.lock.json)
description: Pins one per-repo driver package to its upstream source and records who wrote and who reviewed it. The gate (G2) checks the commit against the task card and refuses a missing licence or author. A model-authored driver of a hardware device at risk R2 or above cannot start a hardware backend while reviewed_by is null.

companions.description: The task card's companion sources (companions, user decision 2026-11-05) as {package_id, commit}, with lock (the LOCK.json alias) for a clone fetched under work/companions, in the card's order: clones at pinned commits that the package's e-stop, its read-back, its declared re-enable and its facts cite (companion:<alias>/<path>:<LINE>). Gate G2 refuses a list that differs from the card's.

lock.description: The LOCK.json alias (<owner>__<repo>@<ref>) of a companion fetched under work/companions; absent for a corpus companion.

install.description: How the sandbox copy is installed (network only during this step).

backends.description: Backend name -> entry point relative to the package (e.g. hardware: .native:connect, fake: .fake:FakeBath).

files.description: sha256 of each package file at lock time (relative path -> digest), excluding driver.lock.json itself.
